name: GDS token business-logic flaw
summary: GDS transferred liquidity-pair tokens to holders during ordinary transfers without consuming a holder-specific entitlement. The attacker split GDS among 100 helper contracts, repeatedly triggered the transfer path, and redeemed the accumulated pair tokens for USDT.
notes: The direct GDS runtime contained the repeatable pair-token distribution path at deployment and remained byte-identical through the first exploit transaction.

USDT Transfer logs show the GDS/USDT pair received 3,600 USDT in the setup transaction and lost 40,852.750053127377203615 USDT in the completion transaction. The net pair depletion across the two-transaction campaign is therefore 37,252.750053127377203615 USDT. This replaces the unaudited imported $180,000 estimate.
